purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-vector access review.
assessment: The thirteen-cell native-CRS run passes 202 distinct valid geometries, forced paging, fresh exact identities, absence, footprint and binding. The wider actual desktop app load exposes additional cells with incomplete native-CRS count/ID manifests and source warnings. A separate sequential check of [-76.624,39.322,-76.623,39.323] reproduces count 61 versus 60 IDs. Runtime is held for wider viewport completeness; no count validation was weakened and no source polygons were filtered or repaired. Previous EPSG:4326 manifest and offset-page failures remain preserved.
registryAssessment: Direct local City EGIS evidence confirms an exact-point parcel feature. The source adapter remains unqualified and disabled.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Baltimore City EGIS parcel map service, layer geodata.EGISDATA.parcel.
Layer metadata (schema before data) identifies a Polygon layer, OBJECTID OID, safe BLOCKLOT identifier, and separate edit/user and other fields not requested.
Official Baltimore City Open Data portal; service is on the City EGIS host.

searchQueries.query: Baltimore City official parcel map GIS parcel boundaries city EGIS
searchQueries.result: Official Baltimore City EGIS exposes a polygon Parcel MapServer layer with schema-defined OBJECTID and BLOCKLOT keys; a point-intersection query with those two fields returned one feature containing the exact WUP point.
searchQueries.method: Separate English search, official ArcGIS layer metadata review, then bounded geometry request with outFields=OBJECTID,BLOCKLOT.

searchQueries.query: Baltimore City EGIS public parcel data MapServer parcel boundaries
searchQueries.result: The City map service supports anonymous query/GeoJSON and polygon output. Metadata was reviewed before a single exact-point feature request; only OBJECTID, BLOCKLOT and geometry were requested.
searchQueries.method: Second distinct English-language query and official service-layer review.

serviceChecks.observation: Polygon layer; OBJECTID (OID) and BLOCKLOT; also contains user/edit/property fields that were excluded from all feature requests.

serviceChecks.method: GET exact point query, geometryType point, inSR 4326, outSR 4326, outFields=OBJECTID,BLOCKLOT, returnGeometry=true, resultRecordCount=3, f=geojson
serviceChecks.observation: One polygon, ID fields exactly OBJECTID and BLOCKLOT; point-in-polygon check true.

qualification.result: not passed; offset paging repeated results in several cells. Object-ID mode passed 10 of 13 cells and forced three-row pagination but failed three ID-manifest cells; no runtime qualification.

privacy: Requests used only declared safe identifiers and geometry. No owner, address, tax, account, or other property record values were requested.
